findings: AI is used for ordinary-view reference images and Tripo base model/texture upstream.
Projection uses silhouette fitting, visibility/depth checks and view-facing weights.
facet_texture.py deterministically averages linearized texture colors over each triangle.
Eye regions within 11 mm of stored eye centers retain detailed texture; current method is hybrid, not strictly one color on every face.
Documented facet mesh was subdivided from 3075 to 12300 triangles, with surface smoothing and small normal displacement; latest runtime body has 12296 triangles.
Reference views and geometry are better matched than the purchased template; this cannot be attributed only to the color storage method.
AI reference views are not independent ground-truth photographs, and documented front silhouette fitting IoU is about 0.50.
v003_decision: Use strict original-triangle corner colors as a controlled diagnostic. Do not reproduce the full catworld generative/remeshing pipeline or alter its files.

v003_vs_catworld.our_geometry: unchanged positions, explicit original render triangles
v003_vs_catworld.our_face_labels: manually authored semantic regions with majority vote and four face-ID eye corrections
v003_vs_catworld.catworld_face_colors: linear color average from projected/base texture, eyes exempt

conclusions: Reject unconstrained image generation of final UV atlases for this experiment.
Deterministic UV baking remains a valid output format; avoiding image generation does not require abandoning UV.
A strict face-color diagnostic is not proof of the best attainable likeness on this template.
AI-only cat.png has no inspectable reference mesh, so image appearance cannot establish true polygon/marking alignment.
